title: Grow the Label
goal: Attach the tag to the base without losing the base.
hints: push takes a single char; push_str takes text.
The + operator eats its left side. Then what does the last line return?
explanation: `push_str` grows the String in place - that is the whole job. `push` wants a single `char`, not a `&str` (E0308). And `base + tag` is the interesting failure: it compiles as an expression but consumes `base`, so the `base` on the last line is E0382, use of moved value. You just met the borrow checker in a string puzzle; the Move or Borrow deck makes this instinct.
